product: AI Material Management Platform (AI物料中台)
product_description: Enterprise-grade material standardization management and approval platform. Manages a five-level standard hierarchy (Category Library -> Category -> Product Name -> Attribute -> Brand) with full lifecycle control for materials through application workflows (new material -> stop purchase -> stop use). Features AI-powered governance, semantic matching via vector retrieval, and a unified LLM gateway supporting multi-provider deployment (DashScope/Azure OpenAI/vLLM/Ollama). Supports both SaaS cloud and private化部署.

warning.name: Warning Amber
warning.usage: Warnings, pending review, AI low confidence

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, SF Mono, Consolas, monospace

tech_stack.frontend: React 18 + TypeScript 5 + Ant Design 5 + Vite 5 + Zustand 4 + TanStack Query 5 + React Router 6
tech_stack.backend: FastAPI 0.128+ (Python 3.11+, asyncio原生) + Pydantic v2 + SQLAlchemy 2.0
tech_stack.db: PostgreSQL 15+ (业务schema + tracer独立schema) + Qdrant向量数据库 (混合检索: Dense+Sparse BM25)
tech_stack.llm: 统一模型网关 - DashScope(Qwen3-Max) / Azure OpenAI / 本地vLLM / Ollama, OpenAI兼容格式
tech_stack.embedding: text-embedding-3-small (OpenAI) 或本地 BGE 模型, 维度 256/768 可选
tech_stack.deployment: Docker Compose (私有化) / 阿里云 OSS (SaaS) + Nginx负载均衡
tech_stack.observability: AITracer自研链路追踪框架 (tracer.spans池) + structlog JSON日志 -> ELK

verification.test_scope: E2E browser tests covering CRUD flows, AI trigger points, and approval workflows

features.name: Category Library Management
features.description: CRUD operations for category library (top-level container). Only super admin can operate. Fields: name, auto-generated code, description, optional library admin assignment.

features.name: Category Management with AI Governance
features.description: Hierarchical category CRUD (up to 3 levels). AI governance: import Excel -> AI analyze -> standardize categories (name/code/level mapping). AI category matching: input product name -> output full-level category path with confidence score.

features.name: Product Name Management
features.description: CRUD for product names with auto-generated codes. Fields: name, unit, aliases, definition, description examples, up to 3 example images. Strongly bound to category and attributes. Extended with PM-prefixed product name codes (PM + 8-digit sequential counter, no reuse) and status column (active/inactive) with soft delete support.

features.name: Attribute Management with AI Governance
features.description: Attribute CRUD per product name. AI attribute governance: import Excel -> AI analyze -> standardize attributes (name/type/options/defaults). AI attribute recommendation: select product name -> auto-recommend attributes with sources (category common attrs, historical data, GB standards). Version control with change logs.

features.name: Brand Management
features.description: Brand CRUD with auto-generated codes. Supports logo upload. Fields: name, code (immutable), description, logo.

features.name: Material Library Management
features.description: Top-level material container CRUD (super admin only). Fields: name, auto-generated code, description, optional library admin. Deletion only allowed when empty. Extended with single admin assignment and category library association.

features.name: Material Management with AI Governance
features.description: Material CRUD within category system. AI material governance: import Excel -> AI clean/structure/attribute-extract -> preview -> batch write with rollback within 24h. Auto-generated material codes.

features.name: AI Natural Language Material Addition
features.description: Input natural language material description -> AI analyze -> auto-link category/product name -> recommend attribute values -> preview -> create material. Includes image understanding for supplementary input.

features.name: AI Vector Similarity Material Matching
features.description: On material creation, perform hybrid vector search (dense semantic + sparse BM25) against existing materials. Score综合: text Jaccard 40% + semantic 40% + brand 20%. Thresholds: >=0.90 highly duplicate, >=0.75 suspicious, <0.75 normal. Cold start: disable matching when <100 materials in library.

features.name: New Material Category Application Workflow
features.description: Material manager submits -> department head approval -> asset management approval. Supports simple approval vs multi-node workflow (configurable). Approved -> auto-create category in library. Reject -> return to applicant with reason.

features.name: New Material Code Application Workflow
features.description: Material manager submits -> approval -> material auto-added to catalog. Reject -> return with reason. Includes reference mall link, 3 required images.

features.name: Material Stop Purchase Application
features.description: After approval, material status -> stop_purchase (not selectable in purchase orders). Also supports admin manual override with exemption reason. Displays status badge in material list.

features.name: Material Stop Use Application
features.description: Precondition: material must be stop_purchased and archived. Approval flow similar to stop purchase. After approval -> material status -> stopped. Cannot be reverted.

features.name: User Management (HCM Sync)
features.description: User list synced from HCM, view-only. Displays: ID, username, unit, department, team, account ownership. Supports add/edit/reset password/delete local users.

features.name: Role and Permission Management
features.description: Role CRUD with enable/disable. Role-user binding. Feature permission configuration: directory/button/API-level access control covering material archives, attribute management, material library modules. Extended with auto-generated role codes in ROLE_### format (sequential, non-reusable).

features.name: System Configuration
features.description: System info (name, icon). Reason options maintenance (stop purchase/stop use reason lists). Approval mode switch: simple approval vs multi-node workflow.

features.name: LLM Gateway (Model Management)
features.description: Admin UI for model configuration: add/edit/disable models (DashScope/Azure/vLLM/Ollama). AES-256 encrypted API key storage. Per-capability model mapping with hot-switch (no restart). Fallback model auto-switch on timeout/5xx. Connection test on save.

features.name: AI Tracing Infrastructure (AITracer)
features.description: Self-developed AI链路追踪: @trace decorator -> Span tree (trace_id root, chain/llm/tool/retriever/embedding spans). Async批量写入 tracer.spans. Prompt version registry. Debug UI at /debug/trace (dev only). Production blocked unless AI_DEBUG=true.

features.name: Material State Machine
features.description: Enforced state transitions: normal -> stop_purchase -> stop_use (no backward skipping). State change only via approved workflow or super admin with exemption reason logged.

features.name: Operational Audit Log
features.description: All write operations logged: user/resource/action/before_value/after_value/timestamp/source (human/AI/system). Log list with filters (time range, type, resource, user). Change detail with before/after diff. Role-based visibility. Export to Excel for compliance.

features.name: Rule Engine (Layer 2 Deterministic Rules)
features.description: Deterministic rule engine for material governance, executed before AI models to reduce LLM cost. Six rule categories: unit standardization (kg/KG/公斤 -> kg), brand alias normalization (苹果/Apple/APPLE -> Apple), title format cleaning (strip special chars, extra spaces, illegal prefixes), enum value validation (check attribute values against allowed options), required field check (verify mandatory attributes are filled), and blacklist/whitelist filtering (keyword-based block or pass). Each rule has category, pattern/value/options fields, priority ordering, and enabled/disabled state. Evaluate endpoint accepts material fields and returns per-rule pass/fail results. Backend CRUD APIs for categories and rules. Frontend management UI with super_admin-only editing, read-only access for regular users, and zh-CN/en-US i18n.

features.name: Material Library Code Rule Management (Backend)
features.description: Material library-level custom material code rule management. Enables defining per-library code generation rules composed of multiple segments (fixed text, category path, attribute codes, date, serial number). Supports rule version management (edit generates new version, never overwrites history), code generation engine with serial number strategies (length, start, step, scope), batch recoding preview and execution with conflict detection, code mapping persistence, and batch rollback with operation logging. 6 new tables: material_library (extended with auto_code_enabled, recode_enabled), material_code_rule_version, material_code_serial, material_code_change_batch, material_code_change_detail, material_code_mapping. 12+ new API endpoints covering library CRUD with code rule config, rule version CRUD, recode preview, recode execute, mapping query, and rollback.

features.name: Material Library Code Rule Management (Frontend)
features.description: Frontend pages for material library-level code rule management. New material library creation page with code rule configuration wizard (segment builder with fixed text, category path, attribute codes, date, serial number segments), live preview showing generated example codes, and serial number strategy settings. Material library detail tabs: current code rule view, version history list with status (draft, active, deprecated), edit rule form generating new version with change reason, recode preview table (old code, new code, status, error reason), recode execution confirmation, code mapping history list with filters, batch rollback UI with risk warnings, and Excel export for code mappings. zh-CN/en-US i18n throughout.

features.name: Category Management Tree View and Bulk Import
features.description: Hierarchical tree display for categories with expand/collapse navigation across three levels (一级类目/二级类目/三级类目). Bulk import with downloadable CSV template (columns: 一级类目, 二级类目, 三级类目). AI one-click import via popup input dialog (10+ lines visible, scrollable, auto-focus at cursor). Backend batch import processing with validation, duplicate detection, and rollback support. Frontend tree visualization using Ant Design Tree component with search, filter, and inline edit capabilities.

features.name: Backend Category Recognition Agent
features.description: Simple async workflow that calls AsyncOpenAI with configurable model (default: qwen3.6-plus) to recognize categories from unstructured natural language input. Parses free-form text describing product categories and maps them to the existing category hierarchy (一级/二级/三级). Returns structured category path with confidence scores. Integrates with the existing LLM gateway for provider/model selection. Supports both single-input and batch recognition modes.

features.name: AI Agent Configuration
features.description: Unified AI agent configuration interface in the AI Management section. Configure AI provider (Qwen/千问, DeepSeek, Moonshot/月之暗面, etc.), model selection via dropdown with manual input fallback, and API key management with masked display. Settings apply system-wide to all AI features (category recognition, material analysis, attribute recommendation, etc.). Provider presets with sensible defaults for common providers. Model capability hints and compatibility warnings.

features.name: Role Code Auto-Generation
features.description: When creating a new role, automatically generate a role code in format ROLE_### (e.g., ROLE_001, ROLE_002). The counter increments sequentially from the highest existing role code number. Deleted role codes are not reused. Backend auto-generation logic on role creation; frontend displays the auto-generated code as read-only field.

features.name: Material Library Admin Single-Select and Category Library Association
features.description: Material library management extended with two new fields: (1) material_library_admin_id -- a single-select foreign key to the role table, restricting the library to exactly one admin role; (2) category_library_id -- a single-select foreign key to the category library table, linking each material library to exactly one category library. Backend schema changes, CRUD API updates, and frontend form integration with single-select dropdown components.

features.name: Material Library Permission Isolation
features.description: Material library admins can only view and manage material libraries and materials that they are assigned as admin for. Backend API filtering enforces that GET /api/v1/material-libraries and GET /api/v1/materials queries are automatically scoped to the logged-in user's admin libraries. Super admins can see all libraries. Frontend sidebar, navigation, and list pages reflect only accessible libraries.

features.name: Category Management UI Layout Refactor
features.description: Refactor the category management frontend page layout to match the existing material management page layout style. Use the same structural patterns: page header with title and action buttons, DataTable with consistent column styling, create/edit forms in modal dialogs, search/filter bar, pagination, empty state, and dark-theme CSS variable utilities. Apply to the category list page and any create/edit category dialogs.

features.name: Product Name Code and Status Management
features.description: Extend product name management with: (1) PM-prefixed product name code in format PM######## (8-digit zero-padded sequential counter, e.g., PM00000001), auto-generated on creation, never recycled; (2) status column with values active/inactive; (3) status toggle edit allowing users to switch between active and inactive; (4) soft delete that deactivates the product name without removing the record (sets status to inactive, code preserved). Backend: extend product_name model with code (unique, non-null) and status fields; add sequence counter; add PATCH toggle and soft-delete endpoints. Frontend: add code column (read-only, auto-displayed), add status switch, connect to toggle and delete APIs.

features.name: Material Library Multi-Select Form Support
features.description: Extend material library management to support multi-select form fields and stricter validation. (1) Multi-select material library admins: replace single-select material_library_admin_id with a many-to-many junction table material_library_admin linking material_library to role, allowing multiple admin roles per library. (2) Multi-select category library association: replace single-select category_library_id with a many-to-many junction table material_library_category_library linking material_library to category_library, requiring at least one category library per material library. (3) Required field red-asterisk marking: add visual red asterisk (*) indicator in all frontend forms for fields marked as required (material_library_admin_ids must have at least one, category_library_ids must have at least one). Backend: update schema, migrations, CRUD APIs to accept/return array fields. Frontend: update create/edit material library dialogs with multi-select components (Ant Design Select with mode=multiple), red-asterisk CSS styling on required labels, and client-side validation ensuring non-empty arrays.

features.name: Material AI Category Auto-Matching
features.description: When creating a new material in a material library that has associated category libraries (from F32), automatically trigger AI-powered category matching to suggest the top matching category from the linked category libraries. (1) Backend API: POST /api/v1/ai/material-category-match accepting {material_name, brand, description, category_library_ids[]}, performing vector similarity search against Qdrant collections, returning top-3 matched categories with confidence scores and full category path. (2) Default selection: the matched category with the highest confidence is pre-selected in the material creation form; users can manually override the selection. (3) UI display: show matched categories as selectable chips/badges with category path and confidence percentage (e.g., '办公用品 > 纸张 > 复印纸 92%'), sorted by confidence descending. (4) Fallback: if no category libraries are linked to the material library, skip AI matching and use the existing category selection workflow. (5) Integrate with the existing LLM gateway and embedding pipeline for category embedding retrieval.

features.name: Qdrant Vector Database Integration for Category Embeddings
features.description: Integrate Qdrant vector database to store and retrieve category embeddings, enabling AI-powered semantic search for material-category matching. (1) Qdrant collection management: create one Qdrant collection per category library (collection naming: category_library_{id}); store category records as points with payload (category_id, level1/2/3 names, path_string) and dense vector embedding. (2) Category embedding pipeline: when a new category is created or updated in a category library that has Qdrant integration enabled, generate text embedding (concatenation of level1/level2/level3 names and description) via the embedding service and upsert the point into Qdrant. (3) Delete synchronization: when a category is deleted, remove the corresponding point from Qdrant. (4) Material-to-category matching endpoint: POST /api/v1/ai/material-category-match queries the Qdrant collection(s) corresponding to the specified category_library_ids using the material's name+brand+description as the search vector; returns top-N results with score and category metadata. (5) Re-embedding job: admin-triggered bulk re-embedding endpoint to regenerate all category embeddings for a given category library (useful after model upgrades). (6) Configuration: per-category-library flag qdrant_enabled to control whether embeddings are generated; graceful skip if Qdrant is unavailable.

features.name: Category Properties Data Model and Backend APIs
features.description: Every category has two property dimensions: own (自有属性) and inherited (继承属性). Level 1 categories have no inherited properties, only own properties. Level 2 categories inherit 100% of Level 1's own properties. Level 3 inherits Level 2's own properties, and so on. Each category attribute has: name, type (string/number/enum/date), options (for enum type), required (boolean), default_value, inherited_from (category_id for inherited attrs). Backend data model: category_attribute table (id, category_id, name, display_name_zh, display_name_en, attr_type, options JSON, required boolean, allow_empty boolean, default_value, sort_order, created_at, updated_at). Inheritance resolution function: compute_category_properties(category_id) returns combined list of own + all ancestor own properties. CRUD APIs for category attributes at the category level. Own properties are nullable (allow_empty=true).

features.name: Category Properties UI and Material Form Integration
features.description: Frontend category properties management UI on the category management page: display a 'category attributes' section below the category tree, showing own properties for the selected category and inherited properties with their source category indicated. When creating/editing a material, if the material is bound to a category, the form must display all required properties (own + inherited) from the bound category hierarchy. Required properties with allow_empty=false must be filled before submission. Optional properties are pre-filled with defaults if available. Visual distinction between own and inherited property groups in the material form.

features.name: Category Management Scroll Decoupling
features.description: Decouple scroll binding between the tree sidebar and the content area on both category management and material management pages. Currently both areas may be in a shared scroll container; split them into independent scroll containers so that scrolling the tree sidebar does not scroll the content area, and vice versa. This applies to: category library page, category management page with tree + list/table layout, material library page, and materials page with tree + list layout.

features.name: Category Table Column Refinement and Immediate Children Filtering
features.description: Remove the '类目库' (category library) and '层级' (level) columns from the category table display. When a category library is selected in the tree, show only all Level 1 categories under that library. When a Level 1 category is selected, show only its Level 2 children (not grandchildren). When a Level 2 category is selected, show only its Level 3 children. The filtering is based on immediate children only -- no nested grandchildren appear in the table. Backend API: GET /api/v1/categories?parent_id={id} returns immediate children; GET /api/v1/categories?category_library_id={id}&level=1 returns level 1 categories for a library. Frontend: remove 类目库 and 层级 columns from the DataTable; implement level-based filtering in the category list when a tree node is selected.

sprints.title: Scroll Decoupling for Category and Material Management Pages

sprints.title: 类目层级扩展：批量导入和AI识别支持任意层级（最多五级）
AI模型配置架构重构：合并 Model 表 + CapabilityMapping 表 + 迁移脚本
features: New Model table schema: merge fields from ModelConfig (base_url, api_key, timeout, provider, model_name, display_name) and AIAgentConfig (base_url, api_key, timeout, provider, model_name, temperature, max_tokens, config_key) into a single unified model table with fields: id, display_name, provider (enum: dashscope/azure/openai/vllm/ollama/deepseek/moonshot/custom), model_name, base_url, api_key_encrypted (AES-256), timeout (int, seconds), temperature (float, nullable), max_tokens (int, nullable), enabled (boolean), connection_status (enum: untested/ok/error), last_tested_at (datetime), created_at, updated_at; add unique constraint on (provider, model_name)

New CapabilityMapping table schema: merge capability_model_mapping and capability_agent_mapping into a single table with fields: id, capability (VARCHAR(50), e.g., material_add, category_recognition, material_match, attr_recommend, material_governance), primary_model_id (FK to Model, nullable), fallback_model_id (FK to Model, nullable), enabled (boolean), created_at, updated_at; add unique constraint on capability; add check constraint that primary_model_id != fallback_model_id when both are set

Database migration: create the new Model table and CapabilityMapping table; add a migration_data_version column to track migration state (pre-migration/in-progress/migrated); keep old tables (model_config, ai_agent_config, capability_model_mapping, capability_agent_mapping) intact during migration for rollback safety

Backend CRUD for Model: GET /api/v1/models (list with ?provider filter, ?enabled filter, pagination), POST (create), GET /:id (detail), PUT /:id (update), DELETE /:id (soft delete or hard delete with constraint check), PATCH /:id/toggle (enable/disable)

Backend test connection: GET /api/v1/models/:id/test -- ping the model's provider endpoint with the configured credentials; update connection_status and last_tested_at; return detailed result with latency

Backend CRUD for CapabilityMapping: GET /api/v1/capability-mappings (list all capability mappings), GET /:id, PUT /:id (update primary/fallback model, enabled); POST creates mapping if capability doesn't exist
Pydantic v2 schemas: ModelCreate, ModelUpdate, ModelRead (full model with connection status), ModelTestResult, CapabilityMappingCreate, CapabilityMappingUpdate, CapabilityMappingRead

Seed data: pre-populate default capability mappings for standard capabilities (material_add, category_recognition, material_match, attr_recommend, material_governance) with null primary/fallback models (to be configured later)
Audit logging: all Model and CapabilityMapping CRUD operations logged with before/after values
Super admin only: all write endpoints require super_admin role check

sprints.title: AI模型配置架构重构：重写 model_for_capability() 统一查询逻辑

verification.command: curl/httpx against /api/v1/ai/resolve-model and existing AI capability endpoints

features: Unified model_for_capability(capability: str, prefer_fallback: bool = False) function: queries the new CapabilityMapping table to find the primary_model_id for the given capability; if primary model is disabled or unavailable, falls back to fallback_model_id; returns full Model object with all connection details; if no mapping exists or both models are unavailable, raises an appropriate error with capability context

Rewrite all existing AI capability call sites to use the new unified model_for_capability(): Category Recognition Agent (F25), Material Category Match (F33/F34), Rule Engine evaluate (F21), and any other AI capability calls that currently reference model_config or ai_agent_config tables

Connection test on model switch: if the resolved model's connection_status is 'error' or 'untested', attempt a lightweight connectivity check before returning; if check fails, try the fallback model automatically

Update model selection in existing AI endpoints: POST /api/v1/ai/category-recognition/recognize, POST /api/v1/ai/material-category-match, POST /api/v1/rules/evaluate and any other AI endpoints to read provider/model from the unified Model table via model_for_capability()

Backward compatibility layer: during the transition, existing model_config and ai_agent_config records can still be read and referenced; the model_for_capability() function should check the new CapabilityMapping first, then fall back to legacy lookup if no mapping is found (with a deprecation warning logged)
Error response: when no model is available for a capability, return a structured error with capability name and suggestion to configure a model in the Model Gateway

Hot-switch support: model configuration changes (enable/disable, update credentials) take effect immediately without service restart; the model_for_capability() function always reads fresh data from the database (no caching, or short TTL cache with invalidation)
AITracer integration: log the resolved model_id, model_name, and provider in all AI capability spans for traceability

Test coverage: write unit tests for model_for_capability() covering primary resolution, fallback resolution, disabled model handling, missing mapping handling, and backward compatibility with legacy tables

sprints.title: AI模型配置架构重构：数据迁移 + 旧表清理 + E2E验收测试
features: Data migration script: read all records from model_config table and ai_agent_config table; for each ModelConfig record, create a new Model record with merged fields (provider, model_name, base_url, api_key_encrypted, timeout, display_name derived from config_key or model_name); for each AIAgentConfig record, create a new Model record with additional fields (temperature, max_tokens); handle duplicates by matching on (provider, model_name) -- if a model with same provider+name already exists from a ModelConfig, skip the AIAgentConfig duplicate

Mapping migration: read all records from capability_model_mapping and capability_agent_mapping tables; for each mapping, create a CapabilityMapping record; if the same capability exists in both tables, prefer the agent mapping (more complete); if primary_model or fallback_model references a model that didn't survive migration, set to null and log a warning

Migration idempotency: migration script is idempotent -- running it multiple times produces the same result; it detects already-migrated records via migration_data_version column and skips them; a rollback script restores the old tables from backup

Migration with existing data: the 414 mock ModelConfig records and any existing AIAgentConfig records are all processed; mock/test records are flagged with is_test flag in the new Model table for easy filtering/removal

Old table cleanup: after migration is verified successful (all AI capabilities resolve models correctly, connection tests pass), drop the old tables: model_config, ai_agent_config, capability_model_mapping, capability_agent_mapping; remove the backward compatibility layer from Sprint 52; update Pydantic schemas to remove any legacy references

E2E testing of the complete refactor: Playwright tests covering Model Gateway CRUD (create model, edit credentials, test connection, delete), Capability Mapping configuration (assign primary/fallback models to each capability), end-to-end AI capability flow (trigger category recognition and verify it uses the resolved model from the new tables), and migration verification (confirm old table data is reflected correctly in new tables)

Regression testing: verify that existing AI features (F21 rule engine evaluate, F25 category recognition, F33/F34 material-category matching) still work correctly after migration; compare behavior before and after migration
Performance verification: model_for_capability() lookup performance is acceptable (<10ms for single lookup, <100ms for batch of 10); connection test endpoint responds within 30s timeout
Final cleanup: remove any deprecated API endpoints that referenced old tables; update API documentation; bump version to reflect the breaking schema change
